About Us
We are a management consulting firm for the Urban Co-Operative Banks, collaborating with visionary leaders to create adaptive strategies for strong governance, Compliance management and healthy work culture in UCBs.
We conduct Management Development Programmes for capacity building of Top Management in Urban Co-Operative Banks. Our objective is to provide technical and advisory services to UCBs through management consultancy.
Panel of experts are Industry leaders from the banking and co-operative sector. Our objective is to provide expert training to Staff, Management development programmes for top management and providing technical and advisory services to UCBs through management consultancy.
Our cost-effective training programmes are designed to improve operational efficiency of staff and help the top management to implement good governance in the organisation.

Our Vision/Mission

Our Vision

To be a trusted centre of excellence for management development, professional knowledge and institutional capacity building in the co-operative banking sector.

Our Mission

To strengthen the professional capabilities, governance standards and institutional effectiveness of co-operative banks through specialised training, management development, regulatory advisory and practical consultancy services.

Why Choose Us

We prioritize governance and sustained compliance, ensuring your bank operates within the regulatory framework, with a focus on driving business growth and meeting customer expectations, we offer well-defined SOPs for business acquisition, fund management, credit administration, and recovery processes. Our objective is to provide expert training to Staff, Management development programmes for top management and providing technical and advisory services to UCBs through management consultancy.

Business growth meeting customers’ expectations.
